import numpy as np
from triad_dynamic_joint import BlockProjection
p = BlockProjection.make(64, 64., ((0., 0.),), ())
for dt in (np.float32, np.float64, np.complex64, np.complex128):
    x = np.random.default_rng(12).normal(size=(2, 64)).astype(dt)
    if np.issubdtype(dt, np.complexfloating):
        x = x + 1j*np.random.default_rng(13).normal(size=(2, 64)).astype(dt)
    got = p.numpy(x)
    ref = np.fft.fft(x, axis=-1, norm='ortho')[..., p.indices]
    print(dt.__name__, got.shape, got.dtype, ref.dtype, float(np.max(np.abs(got-ref))), bool(np.allclose(got, ref, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-7)))
